description: Clean, well-structured English call; every field stated once.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning, Horizon Assurance claims line, my name is Paul. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi Paul, I'd like to report a car accident. Somebody drove into the back of my car yesterday.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let's open a claim. Can I have your policy number please?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, it's F N X dash two zero four five one eight. So FNX-204518.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. And the name of the policyholder?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Daniel Morgan. That's me.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mr Morgan. When did the accident happen?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yesterday, the thirteenth, at around five forty in the evening. So 5:40 pm.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And where exactly?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: At the roundabout where Avenue Jean Jaurès meets Rue de Gerland, in the seventh arrondissement of Lyon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What's the registration of your vehicle?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: GE-418-TR. It's a grey Peugeot 308.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Can you describe the damage?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The rear bumper is crushed, the boot lid is dented and the right tail light is broken.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Was anybody injured?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, nobody was hurt, thankfully. Just a bit shaken.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good. Was there another vehicle involved?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, the other driver is Marc Lefèvre. His plate is DT-775-PA and he's insured with MAIF.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Did the police attend?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, a patrol came by and they gave me a report number, P V dash 2026 dash 091344.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So PV-2026-091344. Were there any witnesses?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: One, a lady called Julie Martin. Her number is 06 87 45 12 36.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Perfect. And what's the best number to call you back on?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My mobile, 06 12 45 78 90.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mr Morgan, I've opened the claim and an expert will contact you within 48 hours.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Great, thanks for your help. Goodbye.
